passages.text: Then the LORD said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and all your family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Noah.
God said, “Go into the ark.
Take all your family with you.
I have seen that you are righteous.
You are righteous before me.
You are righteous in this generation.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ לְנֹ֔חַ בֹּֽא־ אַתָּ֥ה וְכָל־ בֵּיתְךָ֖ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה כִּֽי־ אֹתְךָ֥ רָאִ֛יתִי צַדִּ֥יק לְפָנַ֖י בַּדּ֥וֹר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: You are to take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate; a pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate; and seven pairs of every kind of bird of the air, male and female, to preserve their offspring on the face of all the earth.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God gave Noah clear instructions.
God told Noah to take animals into the ark.
Noah must take seven pairs of every kind of clean animal.
Each pair must be a male and its mate.
Noah must take one pair of every kind of unclean animal.
This pair must also be a male and its mate.
Noah must take seven pairs of every kind of bird of the air.
Each bird pair must be male and female.
Noah must do this to keep their offspring alive on the earth.
passages.original: מִכֹּ֣ל׀ הַבְּהֵמָ֣ה הַטְּהוֹרָ֗ה תִּֽקַּח־ לְךָ֛ שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א טְהֹרָ֥ה הִ֛וא שְׁנַ֖יִם אִ֥ישׁ וְאִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃ גַּ֣ם מֵע֧וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה זָכָ֣ר וּנְקֵבָ֑ה לְחַיּ֥וֹת זֶ֖רַע עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: For seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living thing I have made.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God said He would act in seven days.
God said He would send rain on the earth.
The rain would last forty days.
The rain would last forty nights.
God said He would wipe away every living thing He had made.
God would remove all living things from the face of the earth.
passages.original: כִּי֩ לְיָמִ֨ים ע֜וֹד שִׁבְעָ֗ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מַמְטִ֣יר עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וּמָחִ֗יתִי אֶֽת־ כָּל־ הַיְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: And Noah did all that the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a righteous man.
God gave Noah commands.
Noah obeyed God.
Noah did everything God told him to do.
passages.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Now Noah was 600 years old when the floodwaters came upon the earth.
passages.sermon: Noah was 600 years old.\r\nThe floodwaters came upon the earth.
passages.original: וְנֹ֕חַ בֶּן־ שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וְהַמַּבּ֣וּל הָיָ֔ה מַ֖יִם עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And Noah and his wife, with his sons and their wives, entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a righteous man.
Noah obeyed God.
Noah had a wife.
Noah had sons.
Noah’s sons had wives.
Noah entered the ark.
Noah’s wife entered the ark.
Noah’s sons entered the ark.
The wives of Noah’s sons entered the ark.
They all entered the ark together.
They entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣בֹא נֹ֗חַ וּ֠בָנָיו וְאִשְׁתּ֧וֹ וּנְשֵֽׁי־ בָנָ֛יו אִתּ֖וֹ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה מִפְּנֵ֖י מֵ֥י הַמַּבּֽוּל׃

passages.text: The clean and unclean animals, the birds, and everything that crawls along the ground came to Noah to enter the ark, two by two, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a righteous man.
God commanded Noah to build an ark.
God told Noah to bring animals into the ark.
Clean animals came to Noah.
Unclean animals came to Noah.
Birds came to Noah.
All creatures that crawl on the ground came to Noah.
Each kind came in pairs.
Each pair had a male and a female.
The animals entered the ark with Noah.
They came just as God commanded Noah.
passages.original: מִן־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ הַטְּהוֹרָ֔ה וּמִן־ הַ֨בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵינֶ֖נָּה טְהֹרָ֑ה וּמִ֨ן־ הָע֔וֹף וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ רֹמֵ֖שׂ עַל־ הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃ שְׁנַ֨יִם שְׁנַ֜יִם בָּ֧אוּ אֶל־ נֹ֛חַ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֖ה זָכָ֣ר וּנְקֵבָ֑ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ נֹֽחַ׃

passages.text: And after seven days the floodwaters came upon the earth.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a righteous man.
God told Noah to build an ark.
Noah obeyed God.
Noah, his wife, his sons, and their wives entered the ark.
They entered the ark to escape the coming flood.
They waited inside the ark.
Seven days passed.
After seven days, the floodwaters came upon the earth.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִ֖י לְשִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים וּמֵ֣י הַמַּבּ֔וּל הָי֖וּ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.
passages.sermon:
Noah was six hundred years old.
It was the seventeenth day of the second month.
On that day, something happened.
All the fountains of the great deep broke open.
The floodgates of the heavens opened.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֤וֹת שָׁנָה֙ לְחַיֵּי־ נֹ֔חַ בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י בְּשִׁבְעָֽה־ עָשָׂ֥ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה נִבְקְעוּ֙ כָּֽל־ מַעְיְנֹת֙ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֔ה וַאֲרֻבֹּ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם נִפְתָּֽחוּ׃

passages.text: And the rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
passages.sermon: Rain fell on the earth.\r\nThe rain lasted forty days.\r\nThe rain lasted forty nights.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִ֥י הַגֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה׃

passages.text: On that very day Noah entered the ark, along with his sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and his wife, and the three wives of his sons— they and every kind of wild animal, livestock, crawling creature, bird, and winged creature.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a righteous man.
On that very day, Noah entered the ark.
Noah’s sons entered with him.
Their names were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Noah’s wife entered the ark.
The three wives of Noah’s sons entered with them.
They all went into the ark together.
Every kind of wild animal entered the ark.
Every kind of livestock entered the ark.
Every kind of crawling creature on the earth entered the ark.
Every kind of bird entered the ark.
Every winged creature entered the ark.
passages.original: בְּעֶ֨צֶם הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ בָּ֣א נֹ֔חַ וְשֵׁם־ וְחָ֥ם וָיֶ֖פֶת בְּנֵי־ נֹ֑חַ וְאֵ֣שֶׁת נֹ֗חַ וּשְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת נְשֵֽׁי־ בָנָ֛יו אִתָּ֖ם אֶל־ הַתֵּבָֽה׃ הֵ֜מָּה וְכָל־ הַֽחַיָּ֣ה לְמִינָ֗הּ וְכָל־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ וְכָל־ הָרֶ֛מֶשׂ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וְכָל־ הָע֣וֹף לְמִינֵ֔הוּ כֹּ֖ל צִפּ֥וֹר כָּל־ כָּנָֽף׃

passages.text: They came to Noah to enter the ark, two by two of every creature with the breath of life.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a righteous man.
God told Noah to build an ark.
Every living creature with the breath of life came to Noah.
Each kind came in pairs.
A male and a female of every kind came.
They came two by two.
They entered the ark.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־ נֹ֖חַ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה שְׁנַ֤יִם שְׁנַ֙יִם֙ מִכָּל־ הַבָּשָׂ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֖וֹ ר֥וּחַ חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: And they entered, the male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut him in.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Noah to bring animals into the ark.
Every living thing entered the ark.
Each kind came as a male and a female.
They entered just as God had commanded Noah.
The LORD shut Noah inside the ark.
passages.original: וְהַבָּאִ֗ים זָכָ֨ר וּנְקֵבָ֤ה מִכָּל־ בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֔אוּ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בַּֽעֲדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and the waters rose and lifted the ark high above the earth.
passages.sermon:
God sent a flood on the earth.
The flood lasted forty days.
Water covered the land.
The water kept rising.
The water lifted the ark.
The ark rose high above the earth.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִ֧י הַמַּבּ֛וּל אַרְבָּעִ֥ים י֖וֹם עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ הַמַּ֗יִם וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־ הַתֵּבָ֔ה וַתָּ֖רָם מֵעַ֥ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: So the waters continued to surge and rise greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the waters.
passages.sermon:
The flood covered the earth.
The waters grew stronger.
The waters rose much higher.
The ark floated on the water.
The ark moved across the surface of the waters.
passages.original: וַיִּגְבְּר֥וּ הַמַּ֛יִם וַיִּרְבּ֥וּ מְאֹ֖ד עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ הַתֵּבָ֖ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: Finally, the waters completely inundated the earth, so that all the high mountains under all the heavens were covered.
passages.sermon:
God sent a great flood upon the earth.
The waters grew very strong.
The waters rose higher and higher over the land.
The waters covered all the high mountains.
These mountains stood under the whole sky.
No mountain remained uncovered by the water.
passages.original: וְהַמַּ֗יִם גָּֽבְר֛וּ מְאֹ֥ד מְאֹ֖ד עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיְכֻסּ֗וּ כָּל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ הַגְּבֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֖חַת כָּל־ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: The waters rose and covered the mountaintops to a depth of fifteen cubits.
passages.sermon:
God sent a great flood upon the earth.
The waters rose very high.
The waters covered all the mountains.
The water reached fifteen cubits above the mountaintops.
passages.original: חֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה אַמָּה֙ מִלְמַ֔עְלָה גָּבְר֖וּ הַמָּ֑יִם וַיְכֻסּ֖וּ הֶהָרִֽים׃

passages.text: And every living thing that moved upon the earth perished—birds, livestock, animals, every creature that swarms upon the earth, and all mankind.
passages.sermon:
God sent a great flood upon the earth.
Every living thing that moved on the earth died.
All birds died.
All livestock died.
All wild animals died.
Every creature that swarmed on the earth died.
All people died.
passages.original: וַיִּגְוַ֞ע כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֣ר׀ הָרֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ בָּע֤וֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּבַ֣חַיָּ֔ה וּבְכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכֹ֖ל הָאָדָֽם׃

passages.text: Of all that was on dry land, everything that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.
passages.sermon:
God sent a great flood upon the earth.
All living things on dry land faced this flood.
Every creature on dry land had the breath of life in its nostrils.
All these creatures died.
passages.original: כֹּ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁמַת־ ר֨וּחַ חַיִּ֜ים בְּאַפָּ֗יו מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֶּחָֽרָבָ֖ה מֵֽתוּ׃

passages.text: And every living thing on the face of the earth was destroyed—man and livestock, crawling creatures and birds of the air; they were blotted out from the earth, and only Noah and those with him in the ark remained.
passages.sermon:
God destroyed every living thing on the face of the earth.
He destroyed people.
He destroyed livestock.
He destroyed crawling creatures.
He destroyed birds of the sky.
God removed them all from the earth.
Only Noah remained alive.
Only those with Noah in the ark remained alive.
passages.original: וַיִּ֜מַח אֶֽת־ כָּל־ הַיְק֣וּם׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֗ה מֵאָדָ֤ם עַד־ בְּהֵמָה֙ עַד־ רֶ֙מֶשׂ֙ וְעַד־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּמָּח֖וּ מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִשָּׁ֧אֶר אַךְ־ נֹ֛חַ וַֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בַּתֵּבָֽה׃

passages.text: And the waters prevailed upon the earth for 150 days.
passages.sermon: God sent a great flood upon the earth.\r\nThe waters covered the earth.\r\nThe flood lasted for 150 days.
passages.original: וַיִּגְבְּר֥וּ הַמַּ֖יִם עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם׃
